technical_summary: Workload: real-time reranking + short conversational signals. Avg request size ~128 tokens for rerank (embedding + prompt) and 40-80 tokens for chat. Traffic shape: baseline 5-15 qps, bursts to 120 qps for 30s. Requirements: p50 < 8ms build time, p99 (end-to-end model infer) < 60ms for rerank path. Wants automated fallback routing to lower-cost quantized model when Dedicated pool saturates.
perf_targets: p50 8ms model infer; p90 25ms; p99 60ms end-to-end for reranking. Throughput target: sustain 120 rps bursts with tail <100ms. Cost goal: 3x reduction in per-1M-token spend vs current provider after batching+quantization.
quantization_interest: Very interested — open to int8 -> int4 quantized variants. Willing to accept small accuracy delta if unit cost drops 2-3x. Wants Redwood Optimize to run quantization sims and show quality delta on holdout prompt set.
batch_cache_preferences: Prefix/KV caching for dialog state; continuous batching for steady load; dynamic 'burst' batcher that prioritizes rerank requests. Wants per-route batching policies, ability to pin low-latency models without batching for control-plane ops.
